name: MetallicPaint-TS-TW
title: Metallic Paint Shader
description: A four-pointed sparkle silhouette filled with liquid chrome, its highlights, dark pools and rainbow edges sliding around inside the shape.
use: A logo or icon should look like polished liquid metal in a hero or brand moment.
avoid: It reads only the alpha of a flat silhouette, so photos and detailed marks come out wrong.
a11y: The canvas has no accessible name or text alternative, and the metal keeps moving regardless of motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A sharp four-pointed star on black, its interior a mirror-bright silver with dark liquid patches and thin warm orange edges. Highlights pool near the middle and smeared streaks run out to the tips.
behaves: The metal pattern drifts inside the fixed silhouette, so highlights swell, dark blobs wander and faint rainbow fringes slide across the surface. The star outline itself never moves.
customise: The shape is an image URL, with seed, scale, speed, brightness, liquid, refraction, blur, contrast, light and dark colours and a tint as props.
weight: moderate: A single shader quad is redrawn each frame, plus a one-off image depth pass of 200 iterations.
